title: Repair a nested sum
prompt: A Nested value is a number, or an array of Nested values, to any depth. Return the sum of every number inside value.
hints: What does the starter do when an item of the array is itself an array?
An inner array is a smaller Nested value. The function already knows how to sum a Nested value.
Inside the loop, add sumNested(item) for every item, whether it is a number or an array.
checkLabels: A number is its own sum.
Empty arrays inside each other sum to 0.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Adds only the numbers at the top level.
Has no case for a plain number, so it tries to loop over one.

feedback: Name the base case and the recursive case. A number is the base case. An array is handled by asking the same function about each of its items.
